description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for user registration, login, and profile retrieval in a FastAPI application. It sets up endpoint handlers for registering a new user, authenticating a user to receive a JWT token, and fetching the current user's profile, utilizing dependencies such as database session and authentication services.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router for grouping authentication endpoints.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, delegating the creation process to the auth service, handling duplicate emails and validation errors.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user with email and password, returning a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve profile of the currently authenticated user, based on token info.
